test_r2d2_agent: test the R2D2 agent by running it in a fake discrete environment for multiple episodes
create_simple_network: create a SimpleNetwork RNNCore subclass with an LSTM and MLP for action value outputs
run_environment_loop: run an Acme EnvironmentLoop with an R2D2 agent and fake environment for a set number of episodes
build_r2d2_agent: build an R2D2 agent with configurable batch size, replay size, burn-in length, and trace length
review_simple_network_unroll: review the SimpleNetwork unroll method that uses sonnet static_unroll for RNN sequence processing
